title: Insuring the Fallback: Capacity, Monitoring and the Third Audience in Competence Signalling under Improving AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.26172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When generative AI makes the deliverable uninformative, what a professional services provider can still certify is the preserved human capability to catch the machine's error, and the certifying instrument is a liability pledge whose expected cost falls in that capability. The pledge is credible only up to what the provider can stand behind, and in practice that ceiling is supplied by an underwriter. We make the underwriter a strategic third actor choosing how much of the pledge to bear and how precisely to monitor the insured's engagement policy. Two objects govern everything: the informational retention $\psi=r+(1+\lambda)(1-r)m$, the share of the pledge's expected cost that varies with the provider's type, and the pooled load $\xi=(1+\lambda)(1-r)(1-m)$, the share that does not. Single crossing survives iff $\psi>0$: full cover from a blind underwriter destroys separation outright. We prove a capacity-illusion result: the largest tick

translated_title: 为兜底能力投保：AI持续进步下能力信号传递中的承保容量、监督与第三方受众
translated_abstract: 当生成式AI使交付成果失去信息含量时，专业服务提供商仍能证明的，是其保留的、能够发现机器错误的人类能力，而证明工具是一份责任承诺，其预期成本随该能力的提高而下降。该承诺只有在提供商自身能够承担的范围内才可信，而在实践中，这一上限由承保人提供。本文将承保人建模为一个策略性的第三方行为者，由其选择承担多大比例的承诺，以及以何种精度监督被保险人的业务承接政策。两个对象决定了一切：信息保留度 ψ=r+(1+λ)(1-r)m，即承诺预期成本中随提供商类型变化的部分；以及混合负担 ξ=(1+λ)(1-r)(1-m)，即不随类型变化的部分。单交叉性质当且仅当 ψ>0 时成立：来自“盲目”承保人的全额承保会彻底摧毁分离均衡。我们证明了一个承保容量幻觉结果：最大的……
tldr: 本文将保险承保人作为策略性第三方引入AI时代的能力信号传递模型，证明专业服务提供商通过责任承诺传递“能发现AI错误”的人类能力信号时，分离均衡当且仅当由承保容量与监督精度共同决定的信息保留度ψ>0时才成立，盲目承保人的全额承保会彻底摧毁信号的可信性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the underwriter as a strategic third actor in competence signalling under improving AI, showing that liability-pledge separation survives if and only if the informational retention ψ>0—jointly governed by coverage capacity and monitoring precision—while full coverage from a blind underwriter destroys signalling outright.
